cache_policy: Archive omits historical __pycache__ files. If present they must match exact retained hashes; every unlisted file is refused. Replay redirects bytecode lookup to a new private empty directory and disables writes, so historical bytecode is never consumed.
purpose: Closed inventory checked before vendored imports or compilation. No new numerical result.
scope: Offline dependency-content integrity, not protection against a privileged concurrent operating-system attacker.
